summary: Counter 278 is a VivaCity camera covering seven footpath/lane zones at George St / Margaret St / Curtin Pl; it produced all-zero records from 12 May to 28 Aug 2024 (already set missing), then went silent until 27 Nov 2025 and came back reading 2-5x higher with a much more balanced IN/OUT split, so each zone is split into 2023-2024 and post-2025 series; counter 250 was a two-week 2022 trial kept as its own series. The camera throws frequent single-zone phantom bursts (days at 4-14x the zone's usual level with no matching flow in any other zone, often overnight), and the clear ones are set missing, above all in George St W zone 326. Three level changes in 2026 (Margaret St 327 collapsing Jan-Mar while 328 rose, and Curtin Pl 324 jumping from ~2 to ~170 a day from mid-June) are flagged as uncertain.
